text:
henry: Postmortem follow-up: we need (1) final statuspage wording, (2) customer-friendly incident summary, and (3) a clear RCA access/playbook. Legal flagged sensitive traces. Also noticed recurring kv-sync eviction spikes across multiple incidents. Assign owners?

mira: I can take the statuspage short copy. Will draft a one-paragraph plain-language blurb in the next 2 hours.

sam: I'll own the customer-facing summary and the outreach email template. Plan: high-level timeline, impact, mitigation, and next steps. Will avoid log excerpts and include a short FAQ.

kyle: Ops: I'll open the remediation ticket for the kv-sync eviction pattern (I've seen this in 4 incidents over last 10 weeks). Will add alerting and acceptance criteria.

legal_p: Legal note: prefer "technical summary" or "service update" for public posts. Do NOT include raw request texts, internal IPs, or unredacted traces. For any internal logs requested by customers, require CSM vet + signed consent form / NDA. We'll provide a minimal consent template.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.company/pm/INC-2026-424 0assigned to @henry

henry: Thanks. Mira, paste the status draft here when ready. Sam, target customer email by Thu EOD. Kyle, open remediation ticket with ETA and detection rule. Also propose a new "RCA tiering" policy: public summary by default, expanded internal report for affected enterprise customers on request, and full raw logs only with explicit consent.

mira: Draft statuspage text below:
```
Status: Partial service degradation of the generation API.
Impact: higher latency and intermittent errors for a subset of requests between 05:2205:48 UTC.
Current status: Mitigated  we rolled back the deploy and are monitoring.
Next steps: We will publish a technical summary and a customer-facing summary by <date>. If you believe you were impacted, please contact support.
```
Any edits?

sam: Looks good. Suggest adding a short "data integrity" sentence: "No customer data was altered or lost." Also add a one-sentence FAQ: "How to request more details" -> CSM + consent form link. I'll draft the email and simple consent checkbox text: "I consent to receive redacted internal logs under a signed consent form/NDA."

henry: Good. Locking RCA tiering: (A) Public technical summary on status page (B) Customer-facing summary to affected customers (C) Expanded internal report on request to enterprise customers (CSM vet + consent) (D) Raw logs/traces only with explicit legal-approved consent/NDA. Owners: mira (status copy), sam (customer summary & consent language), kyle (remediation & alerting), legal_p (consent template). Deadlines: status copy today, customer summary Thu EOD, remediation ticket within 48h.

kyle: Created ticket INF-4720 "kv-sync eviction: guardrails, detection, and runbook" (owner: kyle). ETA: 3 weeks. Acceptance criteria: 1) Grafana alert for >3 evictions in 15m, 2) runbook with mitigation steps and playbook, 3) automated safeguard reduces eviction spikes in load test by >=75%. Will attach detection rule.

legal_p: I'll post a short consent template and redaction checklist for comms review. Quick guidance: avoid timestamps that reveal internal topology; sanitize any example logs; do not include full stack traces in public text.

cs-lead: CS will proactively contact top affected customers and keep a consent tracker. I'll share a spreadsheet with owners and contact dates by Fri.

henry: Let's do an async check tomorrow 11:00am PT to review drafts. Final action list I'm locking here:
- Status page wording (owner: mira)  draft today
- Customer-facing summary + email + consent checkbox (owner: sam)  draft Thu EOD
- RCA tiering & consent template (owner: legal_p)  template tomorrow
- Remediation ticket + detection rule (owner: kyle)  INF-4720 created, ETA 3w
- CS outreach tracker (owner: cs-lead)  spreadsheet by Fri

mira: ack :thumbsup:

sam: ack, will post drafts here.

kyle: ack, attaching PR and alert rule shortly.

henry: I'll update the incident board and mark the comms card In Progress. If Legal posts edits, please drop them here so we can iterate before sending to staging. Thanks everyone.
